title: The agent said its budget was gone. It had spent 2%.
metaDescription: A morning brief blamed a spent budget for stopping early. It had used 2% of it — and the same shape of wrong self-report turned up twice more.
tagline: An agent will answer a question about its own machinery confidently, and get it wrong, because answering is not the same as checking.
bullets: The morning Telegram briefing reported a spent budget after $0.28 of a $15 cap — what stopped it was an eight-iteration limit, not the money
All the agent got was ‘budget or step limit reached’ — never which of the two fired
A calendar crossed the 40,000-byte read ceiling on Aug 3; the grinding started Aug 6
It found the right answer on tool call twelve. The eighth iteration was its last.

image.label: Twelve calls in three phases — read, reconstruct by hand, find the assembled view

body: ‘Budget or step limit reached’ was the whole message: two causes, no way to tell which. So it guessed. No bug and no bad data — we asked a question we already knew the answer to, then believed the answer.
A 51,100-byte calendar met a 40,000-byte ceiling and the clip went unmentioned. A solution found on tool call twelve died with the turn, six mornings running.
Every fix sits outside the agent: name the limit that fired, check file size from the trace, give it somewhere to write.
